title: Builder's Kit+
description: All of your building essentials in one!
body:
Builder’s Kit+ is a lightweight modpack designed to enhance vanilla Minecraft building without adding any new blocks! This pack focuses on using powerful building tools, structure planning mods, and performance optimizations to make large builds easier and smoother.
##
Features
### 1. Building Mods 🧱 - [Axiom](https://modrinth.com/mod/axiom) - **For advanced terrain and builds, best for large projects** - [Effortless Structure](https://modrinth.com/mod/effortless) - **For building shapes without making it too confusing. eg - circles, cylinders etc.** - [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) - **For adding, making or pasting schematics into your world** - [Tweakeroo](https://modrinth.com/mod/tweakeroo) - **Adds many, but simple features into your world.** - [WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit) - **Adds many useful and helpful commands into your building world.** ### 2. Performance Mods ⚡ - [Clumps](https://modrinth.com/mod/clumps) - **No more lag due to experience orbs** - [Dynamic FPS](https://modrinth.com/mod/dynamic-fps) - **Minimizes FPS while tabbed out** - [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - **Better enitity culling, reduces lag due to mobs** - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - **Reduces memory usage** - [Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium) - **A sodium addon providing support for the Fabric Rendering API** - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - **A general optimization mod for a number of systems** - [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) and [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) - **A powerful optimization mod, improves FPS and micro-stutter** ### 3. Extra but Essential Mods ✨ - [Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders) - **Adds a borderless screen feature.** - [Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling) - **Adds a search bar for keybinds** - [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam) - **Like spectator mode but for screenshots** - [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) - **Adds the ability to use shaders** - [ReplayMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/replaymod) - **Records you while you play** - [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) - **Adds a minimap for builds or waypoints** - [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify) - **Adds a zoom feature** ## Compatibility 🛠️ - Works in singleplayer - Compatible with most multiplayer servers, but mods like Axiom may only work partially unless downloaded on the server-side as well. ## Disclaimer ⚠ - Best and safest when used in singleplayer or if you own the server. - Some mods may be flagged as cheats if used without permission. - Check the list of building mods, if you are confused. - This modpack can be used as an optimization pack as well but it is best used for building.
